---
title: "JSNA cohort model"
format: html
---

For help and tutorials see the [Mermaid documentation for flowcharts](https://mermaid.js.org/syntax/flowchart.html) and Quarto [pages](https://quarto.org/docs/authoring/diagrams.html).



```{mermaid}
---
title: Simple model overview
---

flowchart TD

%% Core progression
  B([Births]) --> N[(None)]
  N ==> Fs(Flow to\nSingle) ==> S[(Single)]
  S ==> Fm(Flow to\nMultiple) ==> M[(Multiple)]

%% Deaths
  N --> Dn([Deaths])
  S --> Ds([Deaths])
  M --> Dm([Deaths])

%% Ageing chains
  N <--> An(Ageing)
  S <--> As(Ageing)
  M <--> Am(Ageing)


%% Set class defs
classDef noborder stroke:none,fill:none;
classDef deaths stroke:red,fill:#F0D4D4;
classDef ageing stroke:blue,fill:#BBD4FC;
classDef births stroke:green,fill:#DDF3CB;
    class B births;
    class Fs noborder;
    class Fm noborder;
    class Dn deaths;
    class Ds deaths;
    class Dm deaths;
    class An ageing;
    class As ageing;
    class Am ageing;

```
